notes: upon which: the עַל takes upon and the relative takes which, while the resumptive suffix is unrepresented, since the ASV writes two words rather than one fused adverb (rule 22).
no man: לֹא is realized by the determiner no and the supplied subject noun man is added (rules 15, 17).
The marginal gloss (Hebrew whole) is read and set aside (rule 38).
